from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document relevant to the filtering task."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's identifier or title (e.g., 判决文书 4)")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal nature of the case (e.g., 民事，刑事)")
    specific_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action or criminal charge named in the document")
    text_anchor: str | None = Field(description="A brief excerpt from the text confirming the cause or case type")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
